newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Banco Credicoop to issue $100 mln bond.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Banco Credicoop to issue $100 mln bond.

text.p: Argentina's Banco Credicoop has been authorized to issue $100 million worth of negotiable bonds as part of a previously-announced medium term $250 million issue, the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange said in a statement Wednesday.
The bonds will mature in May 2000.
They will have a variable interest rate equivalent to 180-days LIBOR plus three points per year.
Interest for the first period between June 17 and Nov 17, 1997, will be 3.75 percent, equivalent to 8.94 percent on an annual basis.
